scope_warning: This is an expandable current comparison registry for the named agent/governance/control-plane alternatives found in the 2026-09-17 market scan. It is not proof that no other competitor exists. Missing public evidence is not proof of missing capability.

A01.notes: Official docs state default deny and forbid-overrides-permit policy evaluation.

A02.notes: Temporal policies can require a prior approval event before a later action.

A05.notes: Session-history policies can limit repeated actions and correlate prior events; this is partial evidence for replay/duplicate control, not a universal side-effect idempotency claim.

A11.notes: Official security guidance defines least-privilege, explicit-deny, and deployment-boundary controls; this does not by itself supply the full maturity-label scheme used by this benchmark.

records.entity: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service / Agent Framework

A01.notes: Foundry documents enterprise identity/access and integrated safety controls; the benchmark gives partial credit rather than inferring a universal default-deny tool policy.

A02.notes: Tool calls can be explicitly wrapped to require human approval before execution.

A05.notes: Durable orchestration checkpoints completed agent calls/steps so recovery does not re-execute completed work; docs also describe replay/cached-step behavior.

A06.notes: Checkpoints, resuming, rehydration, and durable failure recovery are documented product capabilities.

A07.notes: Agent versions are snapshotted and rollback/comparison is supported; no credit is inferred for a Worldshepherd-style evaluator dependency/evidence manifest.

A10.notes: Workflow observability and several open/integration protocols are documented.

A08.notes: Enterprise self-hosted deployment can run inside customer infrastructure.
